actual.descripcion: DP World Tour Championship, Second Round | Round 2 of the DP World Tour Championship continues from Jumeirah Golf Estates in Dubai. Golfers take on the 7,706-yard, par-72 Earth course during four days of play for a share of the $10 million prize fund. Matt Fitzpatrick won in 2025.
